meta.title: Suggested vendors are added via Invite Vendors
gaps: Verify the green tip itself is present before clicking Invite Vendors.
Verify the exact identities or count of the product-mapped vendors without vendor names or a stated expected count.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the green tip itself is present before clicking Invite Vendors.; Verify the exact identities or count of the product-mapped vendors without vendor names or a stated expected count.

steps.note: Open the multi-stage create flow with its default Auction stage.
Provide the required event title using an automatically generated unique title.
Apply the auction pricing template before adding products.
Add a product whose mapped vendors should drive the suggestion.
Complete the auction pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Click the product-based Invite Vendors control so all mapped vendors are added.
Publish the event to make its participant list observable.
Assert that publication reached a real project page.
Open the published event's Participants list.
Assert that the suggested-vendor action resulted in at least one participant on the event.
